body.name: Pinned package and independent reference label maps
body.construction: For the explicit domain \(\{G\in\{0,1\}^{U\times U}:G=G^\top,\ G_{ii}=0\ \forall i\in U\}\), let \(N_G[i]=\{i\}\cup\{j:G_{ij}=1\}\). The deterministic map implemented by \(\texttt{szonszein/interference}\) version \(0.1.0\), function \(\texttt{make\_exposure\_map\_full\_neighborhood}\), sends this graph domain and \(\{0,1\}^U\) into \(\{0,1\}^{U\times\{a,b\}}\), with \(\mathsf E_{\mathrm{pkg},i,a}^{0.1.0}(G,z)=\mathbf 1\{\sum_{j\in N_G[i]}z_j=|N_G[i]|\}\) and \(\mathsf E_{\mathrm{pkg},i,b}^{0.1.0}(G,z)=\mathbf 1\{\sum_{j\in N_G[i]}z_j<|N_G[i]|\}\). Independently define \(\mathsf E_{\mathrm{ref}}:(B,z)\mapsto\{0,1\}^{U\times\{a,b\}}\) by \(\mathsf E_{\mathrm{ref},i,a}(B,z)=\mathbf 1\{z_j=1\ \forall j\in B_l\}\) and \(\mathsf E_{\mathrm{ref},i,b}(B,z)=\mathbf 1\{z_j=0\ \forall j\in B_l\}\) for the unique \(l\) with \(i\in B_l\). The external and reference outputs supplied to the diagnostic are \(L^{\mathrm{pkg}}=\mathsf E_{\mathrm{pkg}}^{0.1.0}(G,Z)\) and \(L^{\mathrm{ref}}=\mathsf E_{\mathrm{ref}}(B,Z)\), respectively.
